div.p: Across ten paired blocks, staged-flux residual turbidity fell faster after week 4. Median flux retention is also higher, while the cold-water weeks widen both arms. The trial was not powered for a seasonal reliability claim and the two missed inflow samples were imputed from the prior shift.
